_readme: Tuner settings file for leoInsertionV3 (equivalent of V2's b5-leo.json). Sirf paanch tunables vary honge; baaki guidance constants code defaults pe rehte hain. Numbers jinke naam me 'calibrate' hai wo placeholders hain - baseline run ke baad fix karo (PROMPT.md Step 2).
name: b5-leo-v3

mission._durationNote: 320 km pe pad->payload deploy ~600 s (manual best 590 s). 900 s sirf safety cap; payload cleared pe early stop hoga. Bade orbit (e.g. 2000 km) ke liye cap badhana padega - target altitude ke hisaab se config me set karo.
mission._deorbitNote: Deorbit hamesha SKIP (done.DEORBIT_ENABLED=false). Stage residual target 0-50 kg. Suicide-ON variant tuning scope me nahi.

_fixedNote: Ye mission definition hain, tunables nahi. Har eval me tunables ke saath POORA set bhejna hai kyunki Guidance ka _v3Config cached sim instance me runs ke beech persist karta hai.

tunables._timeQuantumNote: 1 sim tick = 1/80 s. T hamesha integer ticks (n/80) me rakho, float rounding drift se bachne ke liye.
tunables._note: Default 0.60 deg x 4.82^2 = 13.94. Collapse: G_raw=A/T0^2 -> round 0.01 -> T_raw=sqrt(A/G) -> round 0.01 -> A_eff=G*T^2. CMA ko A_eff wapas feed karo.
Decades me vary hota hai, isliye log scale pe search.

Quantum = 1 sim tick (0.0125 s), integer ticks me store karo. Effective trigger window = engine startupDurationS + ye lead. Baseline run raw defaults (5.53, 4.82) pe hoga taaki manual 590 s result reproduce ho; lattice snapping uske baad shuru.

scoring._note: Score = LOWER IS BETTER. Hard fail => failPenalty + graded depth (taaki CMA ko slope mile, flat plateau nahi).

maxG._note: runner tracker.maxG ki calculation GALAT hai - use mat karo. Evaluator hook me apni G-load (non-gravitational accel / g0) compute karo, Step 3 me verify karke tabhi enable karo.

circMinRadialVelocityMps._note: vr thodi der negative ja kar wapas positive ho sakta hai (physics). Isliye hard fail NAHI: vr_min < 'min' pe sirf chhota soft penalty (tie-breaker, softWeightPerMps per m/s), kyunki asli accuracy loss orbit terms (apogee/perigee/ecc) me already dikhta hai. Hard fail sirf vr_min < hardFloor (PROVISIONAL -2.0 m/s) pe, graded depth ke saath.

scoring._hierarchyCheck: Unit test likho: orbit error beat karna chahiye fuel ko, fuel beat kare time ko. Weights tabhi final jab ye test pass ho.

phases.name: baseline
phases.purpose: Defaults pe run, metrics + hard-limit calibration + deploy time + wall time naapo.

phases.name: ascent_profile
phases._evalNote: Full run ~600 sim-s hi hai (~6 s wall), isliye default full. Truncated (stopAtPhase COAST_ROTATE) optional speedup, sirf agar baseline me proxy valid dikhe.
phases.objective: apogee within tol + eccentricity/perigee proxy + stage fuel feasibility
phases._note: Lattice discrete hai (G,T 0.01 rounding), isliye CMA nahi, grid+refine.

phases.name: aoa_bias
phases.failureModes: bohot chhota bias => apogee target tak nahi pahunchta; bohot bada => apogee ok par eccentricity zyada

phases.name: circ_lead
phases.method: monotone bisection on 0.01 lattice (zyada lead => burn end pe apogee se zyada door)

phases.name: meco_fuel
phases.method: monotone scan + bisection: sabse BADI MECO fuel value jo abhi bhi residual target aur orbit hard constraints satisfy kare
phases._note: MECO badhao => stage residual kam. Fail point se pehle back off. Baad me phase 1-4 anchors ka ek quick re-verify (max 2 loops).

phases.name: cma_refine
phases.method: CMA-ES 4-D, phases 1-5 ke anchors se warm start, normalised [0,1] space

boundsPolicy._note: Saare bounds PROVISIONAL hain (sirf 320 km manual tune se andaaza). 160 km aur 2000 km pe pehli runs ke baad narrow region confirm hoga.
boundsPolicy._recordNote: Har tune ke baad (targetAltKm -> final best values + jis region me score achha tha) save karo. Multiple altitudes ke results se future tuners ke liye narrow bounds / altitude-based initial guess nikalenge.

cma._sigma0Note: Normalised space me. Warm start hai isliye chhota; cold start ka 0.3 nahi.
